items.source: Provides a PlatformTransactionManager for Neo4j based on the driver resulting from driver().
items.translation: 提供一个基于由driver()生成的驱动器的、针对 Neo4j 的PlatformTransactionManager。

items.source: The driver used here should be the driver resulting from driver(), which is the default.
items.translation: 此处使用的驱动应由driver()产生，即默认驱动。

items.source: Scans the mapping base package for classes annotated with Node. By default, it scans for entities in all packages returned by getMappingBasePackages().
items.translation: 扫描带有 Node 注解的映射基础包中的类。默认情况下，它会扫描由 getMappingBasePackages() 返回的所有包中的实体。

items.source: Returns the base packages to scan for Neo4j mapped entities at startup. Will return the package name of the configuration class' (the concrete class, not this one here) by default. So if you have a com.acme.AppConfig extending Neo4jConfigurationSupport the base package will be considered com.acme unless the method is overridden to implement alternate behavior.
items.translation: 返回启动时用于扫描 Neo4j 映射实体的基础包。默认情况下，将返回配置类（即具体类，而非此处所示的此类）的包名。因此，如果您有一个继承自 `Neo4jConfigurationSupport` 的 `com.acme.AppConfig` 类，则基础包将被视为 `com.acme`，除非重写此方法以实现其他行为。
